in_sanskrit.name: Azaz
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Divine, Exalted One
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Azaz एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Azaz is a name of divine and exalted origin. It is a name that signifies power, wisdom, and protection. In Hindu mythology, Azaz is an aspect of Lord Shiva, the supreme god. In Hebrew, Azaz is the name of an angel who is said to govern the winds.
